messages:
maria: FYI three short p95 spikes across prod gpu pools in last 48h. Looks like bursty traffic + cache misses. Need SLO/alert changes and owners.

maria: spikes ~30-90s at 02:08, 09:12, 15:37 UTC. Error-budget ~11% burn for affected routes. No deploys.

aj: propose 24h operational SLO (set at 110% of monthly) + a 3m alert to catch spikes quickly.

devon: agree. I'll add KV cache-miss telemetry + per-request batch size histograms. Might explain the warm-cache pattern.

kevin: I'll own dashboards & alerting. Plan: add 3m/15m p95 panels, weekly spike frequency, and PD for 3m breach. ETA: 48h.

sophie: I'll review customer SLA wording. We must make clear the 24h op SLO is for operations, not a contract change.

maria: automation idea: if 6h burn rate >4x then pause noncritical rollouts and notify Product+Sales. Agree?

aj: +1, with manual override for urgent fixes.

devon: runbook checklist draft: 1) check KV miss rate 2) check pool GC/CPU 3) scale pool or restart route 4) switch batching conservative. I'll draft.

oncall-bot: incident 2026-04-12T15:41:07Z severity:S3 closed tags:[latency,kv-cache]

kevin: tasks created: dashboard+alert (kevin, +2d); 24h SLO doc (aj, +5d); rollout automation (maria, +7d); telemetry (devon, +10d); comms FAQ (sophie, +4d).

maria: quick sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC to confirm dashboards and SLO draft?

kevin: +1

devon: +1

aj: +1

sophie: +1

maria: thanks all. I'll post tracker links after tasks are live. :white_check_mark:
